outputs.scope: Inventory product selection, cart badge behavior, cart contents, price fidelity, and removal.
preconditions: A shopper can authenticate and access the inventory page.
coverage: Adding one product increments the cart badge.
The selected product appears in the cart with matching name and price.
Removing the product clears the cart badge and cart contents.
Adding a second product increments the badge again and preserves the selected items.

next_recommendation: Generate the manual test cases from this plan.
